fields.name: Oxalis petal vein contrast v1
fields.description: Optional photographic trait for Oxalis oregana and O. smalliana. Score the upper surface of an open flower, independently of petal background color. At a 300-pixel flower diameter, conspicuous requires at least two distinct pigmented vein lines on each of at least three assessable petals, extending for at least half the exposed petal length. Faint_or_not_visible requires adequate detail and lighting but no qualifying conspicuous network. Borderline or inadequate evidence is unscorable. See the project's version 1.0.0 protocol; this is a proposed photographic contrast score, not a species diagnosis.
